item.title: Car crushed by tree limb, lightning and 98 km winds in SA
item.description: Wild weather has lashed South Australia over the weekend with almost 100 km per hour winds recorded in some areas like Port Augusta, while an Adelaide cafe saw a large tree branch smash the back of a parked car. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'More and more challenging to do this job': MPs fear rising political tensions

item.description: After a life spent moving around, the respected singer-songwriter's new album is the sound of surviving and staying put. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Antonelli on pole as he eyes record-setting world F1 title
item.description: Australia's Oscar Piastri will start the US Grand Prix from seventh as young gun Kimi Antonelli looks to improve on his stunning F1 season from pole. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Israel presses ahead with West Bank army operation days before election
item.description: The crackdown in the occupied West Bank has seen homes and businesses demolished following the killing of two Israeli soldiers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: The son of a disgraced former president hopes to win Brazil's top office at a runoff election this weekend. If he does, it will be a boon for US President Donald Trump. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: WA government to consider return of Perth to Albany passenger rail service
item.description: There have been several attempts to bring back the passenger line since it was scrapped in 1978. None has been successful, but with the proposed WA government buyback of the state's freight rail network, a new opportunity has presented itself. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Federal police chief links threats against MPs directly to political debate
item.description: AFP Commissioner Krissy Barrett says there is an "immediate" and "direct connection" between heated moments of political discourse and the number of threats reported against politicians. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Missing kayaker found dead near Geelong

item.title: Have your cake and eat Freo too at this sweet design event

item.title: Volkanovski underscores UFC greatness with record ninth title win
item.description: Alexander Volkanovski strengthens his claim as the greatest featherweight of all time as he defeated Movsar Evloev inside two rounds at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi. Publicado también por: BBC Sport. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Singapore embraces AI for cyber defence, with one caveat: breach transparency
item.description: Singapore is turning to major technology firms to strengthen its cyber defences, even as it presses them for greater transparency over security breaches – a balancing act facing regional governments as they seek to harness artificial intelligence while guarding against the risks it introduces. Those risks were highlighted by an AI agent linked to OpenAI that gained unauthorised access to files on an Australian government website earlier this year, raising questions over how quickly companies... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
